items.title: Medical physics: introduction (taaruf) aur istemal hone wali radiations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter 20 opening text and the radiations used in medical physics (PDF 156-157).

blocks.text: Medical physics physics ki woh branch (shakh) hai jo physics ke principles (usool) aur techniques (tareeqe) medicine (ilaj) mein istemal karti hai, khaas taur par bimariyon ki diagnosis (pehchan) aur treatment (ilaj) mein. Yeh physics ke knowledge (ilm) ko medical science se jor kar nayi technologies banati aur chalati hai. In se doctors insani body (jism) ke andar dekh sakte hain aur mareezon ka safe (mehfooz) aur achha ilaj kar sakte hain. Medical physics medical imaging ko zyada accurate (durust) banati hai, radiation ke risk (khatre) kam karti hai aur ilaj ke tareeqe behtar karti hai. Hospitals aur diagnostic centers mein X-ray imaging, ultrasound scans, CT-scans aur PET-scans isi ki misalein hain. In se doctors bina surgery (operation) ke fracture (haddi ka tootna) pakarte hain, tumour (rasoli) ki pehchan karte hain aur andar ke organs (aza) dekhte hain. Is tarah medical physics jaldi diagnosis, achhe ilaj aur behtar zindagi mein madad deti hai. Is chapter mein hum parhenge ke physics ke principles se advanced (jadeed) imaging techniques kaise banti hain: PET positron–electron annihilation (positron aur electron ka mil kar khatam ho jana) aur gamma-ray detection (pakarna) se kaise kaam karta hai, piezoelectric effect ultrasound waves banane aur pakarne mein kya kaam karta hai, aur X-rays kaise banti aur istemal hoti hain.
Medical physics mein istemal hone wali radiations ka introduction (taaruf)

Radiation energy ka space (khali jagah) ya matter (maddah) mein se waves ya particles ki shakal mein guzarna (transfer) hai. Medical physics mein radiation zyada tar diagnosis (imaging, yani tasveer) aur treatment ke liye istemal hoti hai. Radiation ki do bari types (qismein) hain: non-ionizing aur ionizing.

blocks.title: Ionizing radiation
blocks.text: Ionizing radiation mein itni energy hoti hai ke woh atoms se electrons nikal kar ions bana deti hai.

blocks.title: Non-ionizing radiation
blocks.text: Non-ionizing radiation mein atoms se electrons nikalne jitni energy nahi hoti.

Medical physics mein istemal hone wali (ionizing) radiations ki misalein X-rays, gamma rays aur positrons hain. X-rays aur gamma rays matter se photoelectric effect aur Compton scattering ke zariye interaction (asar, aapas ka amal) karti hain. Positrons radioactive tracers (jism mein di jane wali radioactive cheez) se nikalte hain. Doosri taraf non-ionizing radiations ki misalein ultrasound waves aur radiowaves hain. Matter se milne par yeh reflect (palat jana), refract (mur jana) ya absorb (jazb hona) hoti hain.

Gamma rays, X-rays, ultrasonic waves aur radiowaves sab diagnosis aur treatment mein kaam aati hain. X-rays haddiyon aur andar ke organs ki tasveer ke liye istemal hoti hain. Gamma rays apni zyada penetrating power (andar ghusne ki taqat) ki wajah se nuclear medicine, jaise PET scans, aur cancer ke ilaj mein istemal hoti hain. Ultrasonic waves ultrasound imaging mein soft tissues (naram tissues) dekhne, pet mein bachche (fetus) ki bimariyon ki monitoring (nigrani) aur andar ke organs ki study (jaanch) ke liye hain, aur yeh ionizing radiation ke baghair safe hain. Radiowaves MRI jaisi techniques mein atoms ke nuclei se interaction kar ke body ki detailed (tafseeli) tasveer banati hain, khaas taur par soft tissues ki, aur is mein harmful (nuqsan wali) radiation nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: X-rays, ultrasound, gamma rays aur radiowaves ko ionizing aur non-ionizing mein baantein.
blocks.explanation: Ionizing: X-rays aur gamma rays (in mein atoms se electrons nikalne jitni energy hai). Non-ionizing: ultrasound aur radiowaves (in mein itni energy nahi).
